blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Joint spatial-geometric and analytic function reasoning requires translating a perceived spatial configuration into a symbolic function whose executed curve satisfies geometric constraints. We present GAGR-Lab, a framework for measuring this capability through Cartesian game scenes, explicit function semantics, and authoritative Rust trajectory execution. It distinguishes spatial perception, metric grounding, geometric relations, function interpretation, function construction, and constrained synthesis. We specify four configurable scene-difficulty presets and a prospective 24-cell diagnostic design, while reporting only the subset actually evaluated. A bounded pilot of one hosted model (Llama 3.2 11B Vision Instruct) using two API credentials as execution replicas yields 72 balanced games with 432 attempts, 429 valid provider responses, and no target hits; exploratory ordinary-function prompt variants also fail to hit, while the structured localization interface yields no scoreable outputs. A privileged analytic search control independently succeeds on 600 directional cases from 300 generated scenes, with exact repeatability and 1,200 successful vertical-reflection or translation checks. The framework separates serving reliability, symbolic compliance, and geometric success, and preserves exact model-visible inputs and realized paths. A staged protocol outlines diagnostic calibration, held-out replication, multi-model comparison, and paired robustness tests. The contribution is an operational research framework with an executed pilot and a clearly identified prospective study plan; the full difficulty matrix and comparative model results remain untested.
blocks.zh: 共同的空间几何和分析函数推理需要将一种感知的空间配置转化为一种符号函数,其执行的曲线能满足几何限制. 我们介绍了GAGR-Lab,这是一个通过笛卡尔游戏场景,明确的功能语义,以及权威的Rust轨迹执行来测量这种能力的框架. 它区分了空间感知,测量地平面,几何关系,函数解释,函数构造,和受制约的合成. 我们指定了四种可配置的场景困难预设和一种可能的24细胞诊断设计,而只报告实际评价的子集. 一个一个主机型号(Llama 3.2 11B Vision Instruct)的有限飞行员,使用两个API证书作为执行复制品,获得72个均衡游戏,432次尝试,429次有效的提供者回应,没有目标命中;探索性普通功能即时变体也未能被击中,而结构化的本地化接口则不能产生可评分的产出. 一个特权分析搜索控制从300个生成的场景中独立地成功处理600个方向性案例,精确的重复性和1200个成功的垂直反射或翻译检查. 框架将可靠性、象征性合规性和几何成功区分开来,并保存精确的可见模型输入和实现路径。 分阶段的规程概述了诊断校正、被搁置的复制、多模型的比较和配对的稳健性测试。 其贡献是有一个业务研究框架,有一个已执行的试点和一个明确确定的未来研究计划;完整的困难矩阵和比较模型结果仍未测试。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Spatial geometry and analytic function construction become a joint capability when a model must convert a visible arrangement into a curve that achieves a spatial goal. The model must recover the coordinate frame and relevant entities, represent slopes and spatial constraints, choose a function family, and select coefficients consistent with the intended path. Execution exposes mistakes in that connection: a plausible expression can use the wrong frame, bend excessively, leave its domain, intersect an obstacle, or depart from the world immediately.
blocks.zh: 空间几何和分析函数构造成为一种联合能力,当一个模型必须把一个可见的安排转换成可以实现空间目标的曲线时. 模型必须恢复坐标框架和相关实体,代表坡度和空间约束,选择函数家族,并选择与预定路径相符合的系数. 处决暴露了这方面的错误:一个可信的表达方式可以使用错误的框架,过度弯曲,离开它的地盘,交叉障碍,或者立即离开世界。

blocks.en: We study joint spatial-geometric and analytic function reasoning , also termed grounded analytic-geometric action reasoning: recovering spatial structure from a visible scene, expressing the relevant geometric relationships mathematically, and constructing an executable function whose realized path satisfies a target and spatial constraints. This operational construct concerns the connection between spatial representations and function expressions. It is not established by visual recognition alone, by an admissible formula alone, or by a fluent explanation. Here “analytic function reasoning” refers to interpreting and constructing explicit function expressions under the task grammar, without a claim about complex analysis or formal symbolic proof.
blocks.zh: 我们研究联合空间几何和分析函数推理,也称为基础分析-几何动作推理:从可见的场景中恢复空间结构,在数学上表达相关的几何关系,并构建可执行函数,其已实现的路径满足了目标和空间限制。 这一操作架构涉及空间表达和函数表达之间的联系。 光凭视觉识别、单凭可接受的公式或流利的解释,不能确定这一点。 在此,“分析函数推理”是指在任务语法下解释和构建明确的函数表达方式,而不主张复杂的分析或正式的象征性证明。

blocks.en: Our current setting is a two-dimensional Cartesian world with alternating function submissions. Each agent receives an image, task instructions, and public outcomes; privileged scene geometry is reserved for measurement unless explicitly supplied as an observation intervention. The goal is a reproducible capability profile across component tasks and controlled difficulty, accompanied by end-to-end trajectory outcomes.
blocks.zh: 我们目前的设置是一个二维笛卡尔世界,交替提交函数。 每个代理人都收到图像、任务指示和公共结果;特权场景几何被保留用于测量,除非明确作为观测干预提供。 目标是对各组成部分任务和控制难度进行可复制的能力剖面,并伴有从端到端的轨迹结果。

blocks.en: The central research idea is to evaluate the sequence observe → localize → relate → model → execute → evaluate \text{observe}\rightarrow\text{localize}\rightarrow\text{relate}\rightarrow\text{model}\rightarrow\text{execute}\rightarrow\text{evaluate} through a combination of end-to-end behavior and diagnostic interventions. A hit is an end-to-end outcome; a failure alone does not identify a missing subskill. Similarly, expression validity is an interface result, not evidence of spatial competence. We therefore log these stages separately and use exact-coordinate and prompt interventions to investigate candidate bottlenecks.

blocks.en: The contribution has four parts: (i) an operational definition and six-dimensional task decomposition of the joint capability; (ii) parameterized difficulty presets and a staged prospective evaluation protocol; (iii) an auditable visual-to-function interface backed by a modified, pinned Graphwar Rust core, with matched scenes and balanced assignments; and (iv) an executed single-model pilot, exploratory diagnostics, and independent engine controls. The current empirical claim is configuration-specific. The proposed full diagnostic matrix and multi-model study are not completed results, and no precedence claim or comparative leaderboard is inferred from this pilot.
blocks.zh: 该贡献分为四个部分:(一) 联合能力的业务定义和六维任务分解;(二) 参数化难度预设和分阶段预期评价协议;(三) 可审计的可视对功能接口,由经过修改、被固定的Graphwar Rust核心支持,并配有相匹配的场景和均衡的任务;(四) 已执行的单一模式试验、探索性诊断和独立引擎控制。 目前的实证索赔是针对配置的。 拟议的全面诊断矩阵和多模式研究没有完成结果,从这一试点中无法推断出优先要求或比较领导牌。

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: MathVista evaluates mathematical reasoning in diverse visual contexts, including geometry and function plots [ 1 ] . BLINK emphasizes perception tasks such as spatial correspondence and relative-depth estimation [ 2 ] . DynaMath evaluates visual mathematical robustness using programmatically generated question variants [ 3 ] . These lines of work motivate both the mathematical grounding construct and the need for controlled variations. Our emphasis is a function’s executed geometric consequences and interaction history rather than answer equivalence on a static question.
blocks.zh: MathVista在多种视觉背景下评价数学推理,包括几何和函数地图[1]. BLINK强调感知任务,如空间通信与相对深度估计[2]. DynaMath使用程序生成的问题变体评价视觉数学稳健性[3]. 这些工程既激发了数学地基构造,也激发了控制下变化的需要。 我们强调的是函数执行的几何学后果和相互作用的历史,而不是对静态问题的回答等同性。

blocks.en: PlanBench uses systematic planning domains to evaluate action generation and reasoning about change [ 4 ] . Embodied Agent Interface separates decision-making modules and error types [ 5 ] , while EmbodiedBench evaluates vision-driven agents across several embodied environments [ 6 ] . Our domain is substantially simpler: a planar task-space curve, static obstacles, one active unit on each side, and no kinematics or time-dependent control. That restriction offers interpretable execution and comparatively inexpensive procedural experiments, at the cost of limited external validity.
blocks.zh: Plan Bench使用系统性的规划领域来评价行动产生和关于变化的推理[4]. Emfirm Agent Interface将决策模块和出错类型相分离 [5],而 Emfirm Bench 则在被包含的若干环境中评价由视觉驱动的代理 [6]. 我们的地盘大大简化:一个平面任务-空间曲线,静态障碍,两侧各有一个活动单位,没有运动或时间依赖的控制. 这一限制提供了可解释的执行和相对廉价的程序实验,其代价是外部有效性有限。

blocks.en: The execution substrate derives from the Graphwar Rust implementation archived in the project [ 7 ] . The upstream identifier is pinned, but the experimental global-coordinate trace and square-world profile are local modifications. Consequently, the upstream hash alone does not specify the evaluated engine; the local source and executable hashes are part of the experiment archive. The evaluated model is the NVIDIA-hosted Llama 3.2 11B Vision Instruct, whose official model documentation supports image-plus-text input and text output [ 8 ] .
blocks.zh: 执行底稿出自项目存档的Graphwar Rust执行 [7]. 上游标识被固定,但实验性的全球坐标跟踪和平方世界剖面是局部修改. 因此,仅上游散列没有指定被评估的引擎;本地源和可执行散列是实验存档的一部分. 被评价的模型是NVIDIA托管的Llama 3.2 11B Vision Instruct,其官方模型文档支持图像-外加文本输入和文本输出[8].

blocks.en: 3.2 Strict interface and failure accounting
blocks.zh: 3.2 严格接口和故障核算.

blocks.en: The model-facing protocol requires a single bare ASCII function body of at most 256 bytes. It specifies the sole variable x x , constants π \pi and e e , explicit multiplication, the ^ power operator, and supported function names and arities. Equation labels, Markdown, LaTeX, JSON envelopes in ordinary arena turns, prose, and multiple candidates are disallowed. Structured metric diagnostics explicitly use a different JSON envelope containing a function string.
blocks.zh: 模型造型协议要求一个最多为256字节的单光ASCII函数体. 它指定了唯一的变量 x x, 常数 \\ pi and e , 显式乘法, ^ 电源操作符, 以及支持的函数名称和动能 。 方程式标签 Markdown,LaTeX 普通竞技场的JSON信封 出道人 和多位入选者被拒. 结构化的计量诊断明确使用不同的JSON信封,包含一个函数字符串.

blocks.en: A format validator checks the entire visible answer without repairing it. A format failure is rejected before simulation; an engine parse failure remains distinct. Provider errors consume an attempt under the same announced turn policy. We retain raw visible responses and do not silently extract a convenient substring, retry until success, replace a function, or assign an invalid action a zero-length path. Invalid attempts are included in attempts-to-kill, and excluded from averages that are defined over valid trajectories.
blocks.zh: 一个格式验证器检查整个可见的答案而不进行修复. 模拟前拒绝格式失败;引擎解析失败仍然不同. 提供方的错误会根据同样的宣布的转弯政策进行尝试。 我们保留了原始可见的响应,不默默地提取一个方便的子串,重试直到成功,替换一个函数,或者指定一个无效的动作为零长路径. 无效的企图包括在杀人未遂中,不包括在有效轨迹上的平均值。

blocks.en: 3.3 Observation and feedback
blocks.zh: 3.3 意见和反馈

blocks.en: The baseline observation contains the exact agent-facing raster image, a fixed task prompt, and previous public outcomes. The pixel-plus-coordinate condition receives the same rendering plus exact shooter and target coordinates in the prompt. It does not receive obstacle coordinates or an oracle action. This intervention changes available information and must not be described as an equivalent paraphrase.
blocks.zh: 基准观测包含精确的介质成像光栅图像,一个固定的任务提示,以及之前的公开结果. 像素-加-坐标条件在即时得到相同的渲染加精确的射手和目标坐标. 它没有得到障碍坐标或神谕行动。 这种干预会改变现有信息,不能被描述为等同的诠释.

blocks.en: The arena includes the immediately preceding trajectory in the next image. The hosted adapter sends a fresh system/user request on each turn, with public outcome history, rather than retaining a persistent conversation containing earlier responses. In alternating play, the preceding trajectory can belong to the opponent. Accordingly, this pilot evaluates behavior with that specific feedback interface; it cannot establish a causal learning benefit from feedback or from persistent agent memory.
blocks.zh: 竞技场包括紧接前作的轨迹入下作. 托管的适配器在每个回合都发出一个全新的系统/用户请求,有公开的结果历史,而不是保留包含更早回复的持久对话. 在交替播放中,前作的轨迹可以属于对手. 因此,这个试点评价与该特定反馈接口的行为;它无法从反馈或持续的代理内存中建立因果学习效益.

blocks.en: 4 Capability decomposition and difficulty design
blocks.zh: 4 能力分解和困难设计

blocks.en: 4.1 What the joint capability requires
blocks.zh: 4.1 国家 联合能力需要什么

blocks.en: The spatial part includes locating entities in a shared frame, estimating distances and directions, and representing target and obstacle constraints. The analytic part includes understanding how a function maps to an anchored path, selecting a suitable family, and setting coefficients and domains. Their combination is tested by whether the realized curve reaches the target while respecting the announced constraints. Multiple functions can succeed, so string agreement with a unique reference formula is not the criterion.
blocks.zh: 空间部分包括将实体定位在共同框架,估计距离和方向,并代表目标和障碍限制。 分析部分包括理解一个函数如何映射到固定路径,选择合适的家族,以及设定系数和域. 它们的组合通过实现曲线是否达到目标来测试,同时尊重宣布的制约因素. 多重函数可以成功,因此与唯一参考公式的字符串协议不是标准.

blocks.en: For example, a horizontal target permits a constant function; a displaced target without obstacles admits the slope in Equation 2 ; an obstructed direct line requires a different admissible path, for which Equation 4 supplies one privileged search family. These examples expose increasing structural demands without establishing a psychometrically calibrated ordering for models. A future task suite must separately measure interpretation and synthesis rather than assigning every failed shot to an unspecified reasoning deficit.
blocks.zh: 例如,横向目标允许一个恒定函数;无障碍的被转移目标允许在方程式2中斜入;被阻碍的直线需要不同的可允许路径,为此方程式4提供一个特权搜索家庭. 这些例子表明,结构需求不断增加,没有为模型确定一个经心理校正的订单。 未来的一套任务必须分别衡量解释和综合,而不是将每个失败的镜头都分配到一个未说明的推理缺陷上。

blocks.en: 4.3 Four parameterized difficulty presets
blocks.zh: 4.3 (中文(简体) ). 四个参数化难度预设

blocks.en: The archived generator implements Easy, Medium, Hard, and Extreme presets (Table 2 ). They change geometric displacement, obstacle density and scale, and corridor concentration. These are engineering controls on scene generation, not validated measurements of human or model difficulty. Explicit placement ranges, counts, shapes, and sizes can override the defaults; every evaluated scene must therefore be identified by its resolved parameters, not only its preset name. The corridor-width setting below applies to the generator’s even/random corridor modes.
blocks.zh: 存档生成器执行简单、中、硬和极端预设(表2)。 它们改变了几何流离失所、障碍密度和规模以及走廊的集中。 这些是对场景生成的工程控制,而不是对人或模型难度的验证测量. 明确的放置范围,计数,形状,和大小可以凌驾于默认值之上;因此,每个被评价的场景都必须被其解析的参数所识别,而不仅仅是其被预设的名称. 以下走廊宽度设置适用于发电机的偶数/随机走廊模式。

blocks.en: The proposed diagnostic design crosses the six component tasks with all four presets, yielding 24 task–difficulty cells (Table 3 ). Cells share procedural scene definitions where possible, with independent held-out seeds and validated scoreable output contracts. Appearance changes, additional coordinate information, and prompt scaffolds are separate interventions. They must not be silently folded into the same difficulty label.

blocks.en: 4.4 Current coverage and calibration requirements
blocks.zh: 4.4 目前的覆盖面和校准要求

blocks.en: The executed horizontal, slanted, and one-circle-obstacle families are foundation tasks: horizontal alignment, relative displacement and slope, and constrained detouring. They use custom resolved settings and must not be relabeled Easy, Medium, and Hard, respectively. Their end-to-end shots jointly engage several dimensions; they are not isolated component measurements. The coordinate-assisted condition is a partial diagnostic, the structured localization task yielded no scoreable objects, and function-to-geometry repeatability was checked for the engine rather than independently tested as a model skill.
blocks.zh: 被处决的横向、斜向和单圈-障碍家庭是基础任务:横向对接、相对流离失所和斜坡以及受限制的绕行。 它们使用自定义已解析的设置,不得分别被重新贴上"简单","中"和"硬"等标签. 它们的端到端镜头共同涉及几个维度;它们不是孤立的组件测量. 坐标辅助条件是一种局部诊断,结构化的局部化任务没有产生可计分对象,函数到几何重复性被检查为引擎,而不是作为模型技能进行独立测试.

blocks.en: Before evaluating a difficulty sweep, every accepted scene should pass a reachability check and an independent solution check with an explicitly reported search budget. A grid path certificate alone does not establish that the allowed function grammar can realize that path. Calibration should record endpoint slope, target tolerance, obstacle clearance, and candidate-family success, and perturb one geometric factor at a time. Neither preset names nor privileged-control success establishes minimum necessary function complexity or monotonic model difficulty. Regularity constraints and dynamic fields require separately validated regimes.
blocks.zh: 在评估一个困难扫描之前,每个被接受的场景都应该通过一个可达性检查和一个带有明确报告的搜索预算的独立解决方案检查. 仅一个网格路径证书并不能确定允许的函数语法能够实现该路径. 校准应记录终点坡度、目标容忍度、障碍清除和候选人-家属的成功率,同时扰动一个几何因素。 无论是预设名称还是特权控制的成功都没有规定最低限度的必要函数复杂性或单调模型难度. 常规性限制和动态领域需要单独验证的制度。

blocks.en: 5 Auditable evaluation and experimental questions
blocks.zh: 5. 可审计的评价和实验性问题

blocks.en: 5.1 Measurement layers
blocks.zh: 5.1 测量层

blocks.en: We report four distinct gates: a visible provider response; compliance with the announced output protocol; a valid authoritative shot; and target entry. Additional measurements include request latency, collision and termination counts, closest target approach, path length, and clearance. blocks.en: Each run preserves resolved configuration, scene ground truth, exact input images and their hashes, full prompts, scrubbed provider request/response metadata, visible output, format validation, engine results, dense trajectory CSVs, privileged overlays, a replay dashboard, and a SHA256 manifest. Image data URLs are omitted from duplicate request archives because the exact PNG is stored separately. Secrets and hidden provider reasoning are not study data. An agent’s optional visible summary is an output to validate, not a direct observation of internal cognition.

blocks.en: 5.2 Research questions
blocks.zh: 5.2 研究问题

blocks.en: The broader framework asks four questions. Joint reasoning: can an agent convert spatial geometry into a function that succeeds, and how do outcomes change under pixels, endpoint coordinates, or complete symbolic geometry? Component bottlenecks: can it separately localize, represent relations, predict a function’s path, and synthesize a function from geometry? Difficulty: how do these scores vary with calibrated displacement, obstacle density, clearance, and function constraints? Robustness: are geometry-consistent actions maintained under transformations, appearance changes, semantic prompt variations, and controlled feedback removal?
blocks.zh: 更广泛的框架提出了四个问题。 联合推理:一个代理能够将空间几何转换成一个成功的函数,结果在像素,端点坐标,或者完整的符号几何下是如何变化的? 组件瓶颈:它能单独本地化,代表关系,预测函数路径,以及从几何学合成函数吗? 难度:这些分数如何随着校准的迁移、障碍密度、清除和功能限制而变化? 强性:在变相,外观变化,语义即时变异以及有控制的回馈去除下,是否保持了几何相容的动作?

blocks.en: The executed pilot addresses a subset: interface reliability, end-to-end success with or without exact endpoint coordinates, and balanced side/initiative behavior. Exploratory follow-up varies function examples and the anchoring instruction, and attempts structured target localization. Engine controls establish tested scene feasibility, repeatability, and two geometric transformations. They do not answer the full component, difficulty, or model-comparison questions.
blocks.zh: 被执行的飞行员针对一个子集:接口可靠性,端到端成功与否精确的端点坐标,以及平衡的侧/主动行为. 探索后继工作各有不同功能实例和锚定指令,尝试结构化的目标定位. 发动机控制可以建立被测试的场景可行性,可重复性,以及两个几何转换. 它们不回答完整的组件、困难或模型比较问题。

blocks.en: These are configuration-specific questions. A larger benchmark should additionally isolate function-to-trajectory interpretation, geometry-to-function synthesis, obstacle geometry, coordinate-frame equivariance, appearance-only changes, semantically equivalent prompts, and controlled feedback removal. Smoothness limits, fields, dynamic terrain, and external task-space transfer are distinct extensions, not measurements already established by the current pilot.
blocks.zh: 这些是组合特有的问题。 更大的基准应进一步隔离函数对函数的解析,几何对函数的合成,障碍几何,坐标框架等同,外观仅能改变,等效的提示,以及有控制的回馈去除. 平滑性极限,地域,动态地形,和外出任务-空间相接是截然不同的扩展,而不是当前飞行员已经确定的测量.

blocks.en: 6 Executed protocol

Hosted inference can still vary; these settings do not imply deterministic provider output or a pinned backend revision.

Games have isolated engines and agent instances. Four games may be in flight; all model requests share a process-wide three-second minimum start interval. blocks.en: The primary plan was recorded before its API calls. Prompt diagnostics were added after recurrent quadratic outputs were seen in early primary games, and are therefore explicitly exploratory. The primary configuration was not changed in response to those observations. Three seeds yield only nine family/seed scene blocks; repeated assignments and requests must not be treated as independent scene samples. We report counts and block-level summaries rather than a leaderboard or significance claims.

blocks.en: 6.2 Exploratory diagnostic battery
blocks.zh: 6.2 探索性诊断电池

blocks.en: The prompt study crosses one seed from each scene family, both sides, both observation modes, both credentials, and three prompt conditions, yielding 72 one-shot requests. The conditions are the canonical instruction, a version removing complete illustrative function examples from both user and system text, and a version adding Equation 1 plus an instruction to select the simplest suitable family. The last condition changes elicitation and is not an equivalent paraphrase. Syntax requirements and fail-closed validation remain explicit in every condition. Matching retains the same input image for a given scene/side/observation/credential tuple.

The output includes estimated target coordinates, confidence, a short visible summary, and a function. blocks.en: 7 Results
blocks.zh: 7 结果

blocks.en: All 72 games ended as draws without a target hit. Of 432 attempts, 429 returned HTTP 200 (99.31%). Every successful provider response passed the function-format gate (429/429) and authoritative validity check; all 429 valid shots terminated at world exit. The remaining 3 attempts were HTTP 500 provider errors and remained in the denominator. No malformed ordinary function response was repaired or executed.
blocks.zh: 所有72场比赛都以平局结束,没有目标命中. 在432次尝试中,429次返回了HTTP 200(99.31%)。 每一次成功的提供商响应都通过函数格式门(429/429)和权威有效性检查;所有429发有效子弹在世界出站时终止. 其余3起尝试是HTTP 500供应商出错,仍留在分母中。 没有错误的普通函数响应被修复或执行 。

blocks.en: The successful-request latency median was 1.29 seconds, its 95th percentile was 9.43 seconds, and its maximum was 27.15 seconds. This measures the POST/response interval, excluding queue time. The batch wall time was 21.64 minutes. All 144 observed first agent attempts missed. Both observation modes failed to produce a hit in every one of the nine matched family/seed blocks. Thus no success advantage from endpoint coordinates or either credential was observed on this design; the floor effect prevents a useful strength comparison.
blocks.zh: 成功请求延迟中位数为1.29秒,其95分之9.43秒,最大为27.15秒. 这可以测量POST/响应间隔,不包括排队时间. 分批出墙时间为21.64分. 所有144次观察到的第一特工尝试都失败了. 两个观察模式都未能在9个匹配的家庭/种子区块中每个区块都产生命中. 因此,在这个设计上没有观察到端点坐标或证书的成功优势;底部效应妨碍了有用的强度比较。

blocks.en: 7.1 Prompt and localization diagnostics
blocks.zh: 7.1 及时诊断和本地化诊断

blocks.en: All 72 ordinary one-shot prompt requests returned HTTP 200 and valid functions, with zero target hits in all three elicitation conditions. Removing the complete solution examples changed the selected bodies but did not restore success. In particular, the pixel-only example-removal condition produced quadratics with additive constants, which execute identically under automatic anchoring. Supplying the anchoring equation also did not produce a successful shot on this small matched set. These tests do not prove which instruction feature caused the underlying failure.
blocks.zh: 所有72个普通一发即时请求都返回了HTTP 200和有效功能,在所有三个引出条件下均没有目标命中. 删除完整解决方案的例子改变了选定的机构,但没有恢复成功。 特别是,仅以像素为例的去除条件产生了带有添加常数的四极体,在自动锚定下同样执行. 提供锚定方程也未能成功拍摄出这组相配的小片. 这些测试无法证明哪个指令特征导致了基础故障.

blocks.en: Table 5: Exploratory diagnostics. Metric JSON actions were rejected before execution, so their hit outcome and localization accuracy are unavailable, not zero.
blocks.zh: 表5:探索性诊断。 Metric JSON动作在被执行前被拒绝,因此其命中结果和本地化精度没有,而不是零.

blocks.en: All 36 structured localization requests returned HTTP 200, but none yielded a complete protocol-compliant JSON decision. Visible outputs included prose and incomplete or absent JSON. No requested target estimate could therefore be scored by the announced parser. We report diagnostic coverage of 0/36 and leave localization accuracy undefined. This is a measurement-interface failure; it cannot be interpreted as zero perception accuracy.
blocks.zh: 所有36个结构化的本地化请求都返回了HTTP 200,但都没有产生一个完全符合协议的JSON决定. 明显的产出包括传道和不完全或缺席的JSON。 因此,所请求的目标估计数无法被宣布的解析器打分。 我们报告0/36的诊断范围,没有确定本地化的准确性。 这是测量-界面的失败;不能被解释为零感知精度.

blocks.en: A separate bounded compatibility probe added a response_format JSON schema to four of those same requests, preserving their image, prompt, and sampling settings. It returned HTTP 200 in 4/4 calls but produced 0/4 parseable schema-shaped objects. The planned compatibility gate therefore stopped the remaining recovery trials. NVIDIA documents structured generation for VLM NIM endpoints [ 9 ] , but the observed hosted responses did not enforce the requested object in this probe. This result is scoped to the tested endpoint and requests, rather than a universal claim that the model or NIM cannot support structured generation.
blocks.zh: 一个单独的边框相容探测器为四个相同的请求添加了一个响应-format JSON schema,保留了它们的图像,即时和采样设置. 它在4/4的呼叫中返回了HTTP 200,但产生了0/4可解析的分解型物体. 因此,计划的兼容门停止了其余的恢复试验。 NVIDIA文件结构生成 VLM NIM 端点[9],但所观测到的主机响应没有强制执行此探测器中请求的对象. 这个结果被范围限定到被测试的终点和请求,而不是普遍声称模型或NIM不能支持结构化生成.

blocks.en: 7.2 Earlier development evidence
blocks.zh: 7.2 早期发展证据

blocks.en: To preserve the project’s experimental history, we retrospectively summarize three earlier archives of completed games in Appendix C . They contain 30 completed games, 435 logged action attempts, and nine recorded target hits. These episodes used different requested model identifiers, prompts, token budgets, temperatures, and scene settings, with a historical expression extraction policy. Their counts are not pooled with the current 72-game pilot or its 544 requests. They show recorded successful and unsuccessful platform interactions under earlier configurations, without establishing a controlled model comparison or resolving the cause of the current floor effect.
blocks.zh: 为了保存该项目的实验历史,我们回顾性地总结了附录C中早先三个已完成游戏的档案。 它们包含30个完成的游戏,435个登录动作尝试,以及9个记录的目标命中. 这些事件使用了不同要求的模型标识符,提示符,符号预算,温度,和场景设置,具有历史表达提取政策. 他们的计数没有与目前的72游戏飞行员或其544个请求汇总. 它们显示在早期配置下记录的平台互动成功和不成功,而没有建立可控模型比较或解决当前下限效应的原因.

blocks.en: 7.3 Execution controls
blocks.zh: 7.3 执行控制

blocks.en: The independent analytic search succeeds on all 600 directional cases. The straight-line candidate succeeds on 200/200 horizontal and 200/200 slanted cases, and on 0/200 one-obstacle cases. Thus the obstacle family requires a departure from the direct line under these scene settings. The fixed-budget quadratic search succeeds on all 200 obstacle cases. All 600 selected trajectories are byte-identical under repeat execution. The 1,200 transformed shots all hit; the largest absolute path-length change is approximately 1.36 × 10 − 12 1.36\times 10^{-12} world units. These checks establish repeatability and the tested metamorphic behavior of the evaluated engine on this battery. They do not establish completeness for arbitrary expressions, layouts, or transformations.
blocks.zh: 独立分析搜索对所有600个方向性案例都成功. 直线候选人在200/200横向和200/200斜向病例以及0/200一障碍病例上都成功。 因此,障碍家庭需要在这些场景环境下离开直线。 固定预算四重搜索对所有200起障碍案件都成功。 所有600个选取的轨迹都是被重复执行的字节-同音. 1200个变相镜头全部被击中;最大绝对路径长度变化约为1.36×10-12 1.36\times 10×12}世界单位. 这些检查确立了重复性以及被评估的发动机在这个电池上被测试的变形行为. 它们并不确立任意表达式、布局或变换的完整性。

blocks.en: Table 6: Independent engine controls. The search uses exact geometry and up to nine engine previews, which the model does not receive. These are execution checks, not inter-agent rankings.
blocks.zh: 表6:独立引擎控制. 搜索采用了精确的几何和多达9个引擎预览,而模型并没有收到. 这些是执行检查,不是特工之间的排名.

blocks.en: 8 Interpretation and limitations
blocks.zh: 8 解释和限制

blocks.en: The strongest observed separation is between interface compliance and geometric performance: all successful ordinary function outputs are admissible, yet none reaches a target. The positive controls demonstrate a hitting action for the same scenes, and held-out execution checks reduce the likelihood that these failures are solely caused by blocked layouts or nondeterministic tracing. They do not rule out every implementation defect or establish a model-independent benchmark validity theorem.
blocks.zh: 观察到的最强的分离是接口合规性和几何性能:所有成功的普通函数输出都可以接受,但都没有达到目标. 积极控制显示同一场景的击出动作,被搁置的执行检查会减少这些失败完全由被阻断的布局或非决定性的追踪导致的可能性. 它们不排除每个执行缺陷或确立一个独立基准有效性定理。

blocks.en: The coordinate intervention and the two prompt variants leave hit outcomes at the same floor. The example-removal results show that simply deleting the complete sample function is insufficient in this setup. The JSON diagnostic failures also show that a decomposition can be unusable when its output contract is not supported by the observed model–endpoint behavior. Consequently, this study supports careful interface auditing and further elicitation work; it does not justify attributing the end-to-end failure solely to localization, mathematical reasoning, or feedback use.
blocks.zh: 坐标干预和两个即时变体使结果落在同一层。 实例去除结果表明,简单地删除完整的样本功能在此设置中是不够的. JSON诊断失败也表明,当其输出合同没有被所观察到的模型-端点行为支持时,分解可能无法被使用. 因此,本研究支持认真的接口审计和进一步引出工作;它不能证明把端到端的失败完全归因于本地化、数学推理或反馈的使用。

blocks.en: The main design includes only one hosted model, three seeds, one raster renderer, one language, a fixed grammar contract, and a small obstacle family. The coordinate intervention removes uncertainty about endpoint positions while leaving several other challenges intact: obstacle perception, global-coordinate semantics, function selection, and instruction use. Consequently, a failed coordinate-conditioned shot cannot be assigned to one subskill without further intervention. A difference between prompt conditions shows elicitation sensitivity, not a discovered latent algorithm or a causal explanation of internal computation.
blocks.zh: 主设计仅包括一个主机模型,三个种子,一个光栅渲染器,一个语言,一个固定的语法合同,以及一个小障碍家族. 坐标干预消除了终点位置的不确定性,同时留下了其他几个挑战:障碍感知,全局坐标语义,函数选择和指令使用. 因此,没有进一步干预,便不能将一个有坐标条件的失败射击分配给一个子技能。 即时条件的区别表明引出灵敏度,而不是被发现的潜入算法或内部计算因果解释.

blocks.en: Repetitions share scenes, prompts, and provider infrastructure. The three family blocks generated with a given seed can also share endpoint geometry. Request-level success intervals based on independent Bernoulli sampling would overstate the effective sample size. No meaningful relative strength estimate can be obtained by fitting ratings to two credentials of the same model. Historical runs in the project used other models, prompts, token caps, timeouts, and throttling conditions; they are provenance evidence, not a controlled comparison with this study.
blocks.zh: 重复者分享场景、提示和提供者基础设施。 由给定种子所生成的三个家族块也可以共享端点几何. 基于伯努利独立取样的要求一级成功间隔将夸大有效取样规模。 通过对同一模式的两份证书进行评级,无法得出有意义的相对强度估计。 项目中的历史运行使用了其他模型,提示,符号封顶,超时和节流条件;它们都是出处证据,而不是与本研究的可控比较.

blocks.en: This planar function task does not measure full robotic control. It omits inverse kinematics, dynamics, timing, actuator bounds, self-collision, and partial observability beyond the raster interface. A visual warp is not intrinsic curvature, and a path-cost metric is not a force field. The native Rust pilot uses a Euclidean world with static hard terrain. Extensions must specify their mechanics and validate their constructs before they are reported as results.
blocks.zh: 这个平面函数任务并不测量完整的机器人控制. 它会省略出反向动能,动力学,定时学,动能极限学,自相碰撞学,以及光栅界面外的部分可观察性. 视觉曲面不是内在的曲面,路径成本度量不是力场. 本土的"罗斯特"飞行员使用一个具有静态硬地地貌的欧克利德人世界. 扩展必须具体说明其力学并验证其构造,然后才能报告为结果。

blocks.en: 9 Prospective staged experimental plan
blocks.zh: 9 展望阶段实验计划

blocks.en: This section records a study plan, not additional observations or a preregistration claim. It is written after the reported pilot. The implemented difficulty presets, partially reusable runners, and planned diagnostic prompts must be distinguished from a fully implemented or completed 24-cell benchmark. Model counts and sample sizes below are illustrative fixed-budget designs to be finalized before new API calls.
blocks.zh: 本节记录的是研究计划,而非补充意见或预先登记要求. 它是在报告的飞行员之后写的。 已执行的难度预设,部分可再用跑道,以及计划中的诊断提示必须与一个完全执行或完成的24个细胞基准区分开来. 下面的模型计数和样本大小是说明性的固定预算设计,将在新的API呼叫之前定稿.

blocks.en: 9.1 Stage 0: execution and interface qualification
blocks.zh: 9.1 第0阶段:执行和接口资格

blocks.en: Preserve source, prompt, and renderer versions; validate scene solvability; verify repeatable execution; and use balanced side/initiative assignments. The existing offline controls and arena logs cover parts of this stage. Ordinary-function format compliance passed for the tested model, but the localization JSON contract did not. Before adding localization accuracy to a benchmark report, establish an output interface that yields scoreable estimates and retain failures as diagnostic coverage. Any fallback schema, token budget, or parser change is a separately recorded intervention, not a repaired retrospective answer.
blocks.zh: 保存源,即时,和渲染器版本;验证场景可溶解性;验证可重复执行;并使用平衡的侧/主动任务. 现有的离线控制和竞技场日志覆盖了这个阶段的部分内容. 普通功能格式的遵守通过测试模型,但本地化JSON合同没有通过. 在将本地化精度添加到基准报告中之前,建立输出界面,得出可评分的估计数并保留故障作为诊断范围. 任何退后方案、象征性预算或改革是单独记录的干预,而不是修复的追溯性答案。

blocks.en: 9.2 Stage 1: component and difficulty diagnostics
blocks.zh: 9.2 第1阶段:组成部分和困难诊断

blocks.en: Construct the six tasks in Table 1 across the four presets, with independently scoreable prompts and held-out scenes. An initial plan of 10 scenes per cell and three distinct, verified vision-language models gives 6 × 4 × 10 × 3 = 720 6\times 4\times 10\times 3=720 one-shot requests for one fixed observation/prompt condition. This number excludes qualification calls, added information conditions, and robustness pairs. The complete battery and its model results are not present in the current archive.
blocks.zh: 构造表1中跨越四个预设的6个任务,并有独立的可计分提示和被搁置的场景. 初步计划每个细胞有10个场景和3个不同,经过验证的视觉语言模型,给出了6×4×10×3=720 6\times 4\times 10\times 3=720个一发请求,一个固定的观测/即时条件. 这一数字不包括资格要求、附加信息条件和稳健性对。 完整的电池及其模型结果没有在目前的档案中出现.

blocks.en: Freeze the sampled scenes before evaluation. Report output coverage with every conditional accuracy/error score, and keep scene-generation rejection counts. For synthesis, report first-shot success and validness; for localization and relation tasks, report errors in world units and normalized errors where appropriate. Diagnostic estimates should be compared with end-to-end trajectories without assuming that a diagnostic answer is an observation of the same internal process used during play. Difficulty should be calibrated empirically and by solvability controls before a cross-level capability curve is interpreted.
blocks.zh: 在评价前冻结抽样的场景。 以每个有条件的准确度/误差分数报告产出覆盖率,并保留场景生成拒绝计数. 为综合起见,报告一拍成功和有效性;为本地化和关系任务,报告世界单位出错,并酌情报告正常化出错. 诊断估计应当与端到端的轨迹相提并论,而不要假设诊断答案是对玩耍时使用的同一种内部过程的观察. 在对跨级能力曲线进行解释之前,应根据经验并通过可溶性控制来校正难度。

blocks.en: 9.3 Stage 2: held-out replication and multi-model arena
blocks.zh: 9.3 第2阶段:暂停复制和多模式舞台

blocks.en: The existing expansion wrapper can prepare a 50-seed replication of the current three custom families, two observation conditions, and four assignments: 3 × 50 × 2 × 4 = 1,200 3\times 50\times 2\times 4=1{,}200 games and at most 7,200 attempts for one homogeneous-model replica pairing at the six-turn horizon. This is an executable expansion plan, not a batch already run. It does not implement the entire 24-cell diagnostic design or create distinct models by changing credential labels.
blocks.zh: 现有的扩展包装可以准备50个种子复制当前3个定制家庭,2个观察条件,以及4个任务: 3×50×2×4 = 1200 3×Times 50×Times 50×Times 4=1{,}200个游戏,最多7200个尝试在6个回合的地平线进行一款同型相仿配对. 这是一个可执行的扩展计划,不是已经运行的批次. 它不执行整个24细胞诊断设计,也不通过改变证书标签来创造出不同的模型.

blocks.en: For comparative evaluation, use distinct verified model IDs, align information and prompts, and qualify their output interfaces. With M M models and S S scenes in each stratum, all pairs require 4 ​ S ​ ( M 2 ) 4S\binom{M}{2} games per stratum. As an example, three models, 50 seeds, the three current families, and two observation conditions give 3 × 50 × 2 × 4 × ( 3 2 ) = 3,600 3\times 50\times 2\times 4\times\binom{3}{2}=3{,}600 games, with at most 21,600 attempts. A four-preset sweep would be a separate, newly calibrated design rather than a relabeling of these three families.
blocks.zh: 为了进行比较评价,使用不同的经核实的模型ID,调整信息和提示,并限定其输出界面。 每层都有MM型和S S相机场景,所有配对需要每层4 S (M 2) 4S\binom{M}{2}游戏. 例如: 三款型号,出出50个种子,出3个出3个出3个出3个出3个出3个出3个出3个出3个出2个出2个出3个出2个出2个出2个出2个出2个出2个出2个出2个出2个出2个出3个出3个出2个出3个出3个出3个出3个出3个出3个出2个出3个出2个出2个出2个出2个出2个出2个出2个出3个出3个出3个出3个出3个出2个出2个出3个出2个出2个出3个出3个出3个出3个出3个出3个出3个出3个出3个出3个出3个出3个出3个出3个出3个出3个出3个出3个出3个出3个出3个出3个出3个出3个出3个出3个出3个出3个出3个出3个出3个 四分卫的扫荡将是一个单独的,新校准的设计,而不是对这三个家族的再贴上标签.

blocks.en: Report per-model and per-stratum hit rates, invalid-action profiles, first-shot success, kill-by-attempt curves, and path metrics with their applicable denominators. Scene-level paired differences and seed-clustered uncertainty should accompany comparisons; repeated turns and swapped assignments are not independent scene samples. Use ratings only if decisive outcomes support them, and retain draws and provider failures. Do not rerun difficult or failed cells selectively.
blocks.zh: 报告每个模型和每个层的命中率,无效动作剖面,一发成功,逐一击杀曲线,以及路径测量及其适用的分母. 场景等级对等差异和种子集群的不确定性应伴随比较;反复转弯和互换的任务不是独立的场景样本. 只有在决定性结果支持它们时才使用评级,并保留绘图和提供者的失败。 不选择性重运行困难或失败的单元格 。

blocks.en: 9.4 Stage 3: robustness, information, and feedback interventions
blocks.zh: 9.4 国家 第3阶段:稳健性、信息和反馈干预

blocks.en: Use smaller matched subsets for exact endpoint or full-geometry assistance, vertical transforms, appearance-only changes, prompt paraphrases, and scaffolds. Exact geometry must be supplied without a reference answer or engine-search access. Function-to-path and geometry-to-function tests should both use the announced anchoring rule and finite tracing domain. Horizontal reflection and scaling require verified transformed actions and numerical controls before inclusion.
blocks.zh: 使用更小的匹配子集来进行精确的端点或全地几何辅助,垂直变换,只外观变化,即时解说和脚手架. 精确的几何必须提供,没有参考答案或引擎搜索访问. 函数对路径和几何对功能的测试应同时使用所宣布的锚定规则和有限追踪域。 横向反射和缩放需要经过核实的转变行动和数值控制后才能纳入。

blocks.en: For feedback tests, compare observations without feedback with the current interface displaying the preceding trajectory and public outcomes on matched scenes. A persistent-conversation condition is a separate experimental factor. Predefine whether previous actions, outcomes, opponent traces, or chat messages are visible, and compare success by attempt without assuming that a later successful shot demonstrates learning. Model-by-prompt sensitivity and appearance consistency should remain separate from information gains.
blocks.zh: 对于反馈测试,将没有反馈的观察与当前界面比较,在相匹配的场景上显示之前的轨迹和公共结果. 持久对质条件是一个单独的实验因子. 预先确定先前的动作,结果,对手痕迹,或聊天消息是否可见,并用尝试来比较成功,而不假设后期的成功镜头会显示学习. 模型逐一的敏感性和外观的一致性应与信息收益分开。

blocks.en: 9.5 Stage 4: independently validated extensions
blocks.zh: 9.5 第4阶段:独立验证的延长

blocks.en: Introduce clearance and trajectory regularity constraints before fields or dynamic obstacles. Each extension must specify its semantics, feasibility control, and new failure modes. External-renderer and independent task-space tests are needed before claiming transfer beyond Graphwar; robotic dynamics and intrinsic non-Euclidean motion remain outside the current results.
blocks.zh: 在田地或动态障碍之前引入清除和轨迹规律性限制。 每个扩展必须指定其语义,可行性控制和新的失败模式. 在声称转移超越Graphwar之前,需要进行外部的和独立的任务空间测试;机器人动力学和内在的非欧几利得运动仍然在目前的结果之外。

blocks.en: The resource policy for new batches can retain four local workers sharing at most 30% of logical CPU capacity and a shared provider-aware request limiter. Local parallelism does not guarantee remote inference capacity, and the illustrative budgets above are not a measurement of provider quota or cost. Expand the canonical condition first, then allocate smaller diagnostic subsets instead of exhaustively crossing every model, prompt, field, and difficulty factor.
blocks.zh: 新批次的资源政策可以保留最多共享30%逻辑CPU容量的4名本地工人,以及共享提供者-意识请求限制器. 地方平行性不能保证远距离推论能力,上面的说明性预算不能衡量提供者的配额或成本。 首先扩展犬科条件,然后分配更小的诊断子集,而不是详尽地跨越每一个模型,即时,字段,和难度因子.

blocks.en: 10 Reproducibility and artifact status
blocks.zh: 10 复制品和文物状况

blocks.en: The experiment archive includes primary and exploratory plans, executable runners, frozen Python sources and prompt bank, authoritative bridge provenance, full run records, numerical analysis, and file manifests. The upstream identifier is fd12c9f4df7459c8124046c9df4f864366f3762f ; local changes and hashes are archived separately. The bridge and vendored core are subject to their recorded GPL licensing; third-party provenance accompanies the archive. The paper source and local evidence bundle are prepared for author review. No public data repository or arXiv deposit is asserted in this draft, and author metadata must be completed before submission.
blocks.zh: 实验档案包括主要和探索性计划、可执行跑道、被冻结的Python源和即时银行、权威桥出处、全跑道记录、数字分析和文件清单。 上游标识为fd12c9f4df7459c8124046c9df4f864366f3762f;局部变化和散列分别存档. 该桥和销售商核心须遵守他们记录的GPL许可;第三方出处与档案相伴. 纸质来源和当地证据捆绑是准备供作者审查的. 本草案没有声称公共数据储存库或arXiv交存,作者元数据必须在提交前完成。

blocks.en: The prospective capability/difficulty design is recorded separately from the executed plans. Four scene presets are implemented in the archived generator, while independent prompts, output qualification, and scoring for the full diagnostic matrix remain development tasks. No empty result cells are presented as observations.
blocks.zh: 未来的能力/困难设计与执行的计划分开记录。 在存档生成器中实施了四个场景预设,而独立的提示,输出资格,以及完整诊断矩阵的评分仍然是开发任务. 没有空结果单元格显示为观测。

blocks.en: AI-assisted preparation. A Codex assistant was used to inspect the project, develop and execute experimental scripts, aggregate archived results, check references, and draft and revise the manuscript. Numerical claims are linked to the retained records. Human authors must review the methods, sources, code, and claims and take responsibility for the final submitted text; the assistant is not an author. Model-visible outputs are archived, without collecting hidden provider reasoning.
blocks.zh: AI辅助准备. 使用一个Codex助手来检查项目,开发和执行实验脚本,汇总存档结果,检查参考文献,并起草和修改手稿. 数字索赔与保留记录相联系。 人类作者必须审查方法、来源、代码和主张,并对最后提交的案文负责;助理不是作者。 模型可见输出被存档,而不收集隐藏提供者推理.

blocks.en: 11 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 11 结论

blocks.en: GAGR-Lab operationalizes joint spatial-geometric and analytic function reasoning through the observable consequences of a submitted function. Six component tasks and four parameterized presets organize a prospective capability-and-difficulty profile; trajectory execution supplies the end-to-end criterion. The executed single-model pilot demonstrates that symbolic compliance can coexist with geometric failure, while privileged controls establish solvability for the tested scenes. The staged plan makes the remaining component, difficulty, robustness, and multi-model questions explicit. This early research framework and pilot provide a basis for reproducible expansion, without presenting the proposed full benchmark as an accomplished result.
blocks.zh: GAGR-Lab通过提交函数的可观察到的后果,将联合空间几何和分析函数推理付诸实施。 6项组成部分任务和4个参数化的预设组织了一个预期的能力和困难剖面;轨迹执行提供了端到端的标准. 被执行的单模型飞行员表明,象征性的遵守可以与几何故障并存,而特权控制则为被测试的场景确立了可溶性. 分阶段计划明确了剩余组成部分、难度、稳健性和多模式问题。 这一早期研究框架和试点为可再生扩展提供了基础,但没有将拟议的全面基准作为已取得的成果。

blocks.en: The three primary seeds are 2026100701 , 2026100702 , and 2026100703 . The scheduling seed is 20261007 . Offline controls use seeds 2026101000 – 2026101099 . Exploratory prompt jobs use the first primary seed and scheduling seed 20261008 . All primary and one-shot prompt requests use temperature zero, top- p p one, and a 128-token cap. Structured metric trials use a 256-token cap. The provider timeout is 60 seconds, and errors remain attempts. Endpoint request starts are separated by at least three seconds within each active battery.

blocks.en: Before an expansion, verify the screenshot actually supplied to each request; compare the prompt and image hashes across matched cells; inspect provider failures separately from format and engine failures; replay representative hits and misses; verify all scheduled jobs have an explicit terminal status; check target-distance and path metrics against the trajectory CSV; and verify manifests. An empty or malformed response is not a zero-length valid path. Request latency excludes waiting in the global request-start limiter; batch wall time includes that waiting.
blocks.zh: 在扩展前,核查实际提供给每个请求的截图;对匹配单元格的快取和图像散列进行比较;分别检查供应商故障和引擎故障;重放代表命中和错取;核实所有预定任务都有明确的终端状态;对照轨迹CSV检查目标距离和路径测量;并核实出货单. 空或畸形的反应不是零长的有效路径. 请求延迟排除了在全球请求启动限制器中的等待;批次墙上的时间包括等待。

blocks.en: The earlier resolved configurations request the Rust backend, a square world profile, 1296-pixel square images, and a Hard preset with a 4–9 obstacle-count override. These differ from the current foundation scenes and 1024-pixel renderer. Model identifiers above are the labels stored in historical requests, not an independent assertion about current catalog availability or backend identity. Exact historical executable and hosted-backend revisions are not newly established by the retrospective archive. Unequal output budgets, prompt versions, extraction, service failures, and assignments confound inter-model comparisons. Recorded hits therefore cannot be presented as improvement over the current model or as a validated cross-difficulty result. API archive files and logged action attempts are counted separately, since the historical archive can contain exchanges beyond scored turns.
blocks.zh: 早先解析的配置请求了 Rust 后端,一个正方形世界剖面图, 1296-像素平面图像, 以及一个带有 4–9 障碍计数的硬预设 。 这些与目前的地基场景和1024像素渲染器不同. 上面的模型标识是存储在历史请求中的标签,而不是关于当前目录可用性或后端身份的独立断言. 确切的历史可执行性和主机后端修订不是由追溯档案新建立的. 产出预算不均、即时版本、取出、服务失败和任务使模型间比较混乱。 因此,无法将有记录的点击率说成是对现有模型的改进,或说是经过验证的交叉困难结果。 API存档文件和已登录的动作尝试被单独计算,因为历史档案可以包含超过得分转折的交换.

blocks.en: A separate pre-pilot strict-interface smoke check on 7 October 2026 used the current Llama model in a fixed horizontal, obstacle-free scene with both credentials and both directions. All 4 requests returned HTTP 200, passed strict-format and engine-validity checks, and missed the target. Response latencies ranged from 0.80 to 1.19 seconds. The archived earlier prompt-calibration responses illustrate why explicit grammar and whole-response validation were introduced. Calibration and development checks were not randomized controls and are excluded from the primary study denominators.
blocks.zh: 2026年10月7日单独进行试运行前严格相交式烟雾检查,在固定水平,无障碍的场景中使用了目前的"Llama"型号,既有合格证也有双向. 所有4个请求都退回了HTTP 200,通过了严格的格式和引擎有效性检查,并错过了目标. 反应延迟从0.80秒到1.19秒不等. 已存档的早期快速校正答复说明了为什么采用了明确的语法和全响应验证. 校准和开发检查不是随机化的控制,被排除在主要研究分母之外。
